JUCHE PHILOSOPHY

SOVEREIGNTY OF
MIND AND STATE
JUCHE IN IDEOLOGY
• The Requirement: Eradicate flunkeyism and national
nihilism.
• The Method: Know your own history, geography, and
party policy before imitating others.
• The Goal: Establish a monolithic ideological system.
INDEPENDENCE IN POLITICS
• The Requirement: Formulate and implement all policies
independently.
• The Threat: Yielding to foreign pressure or acting at
the instigation of others ruins the revolution.
• Foreign Relations: Complete equality and sovereignty.
No superior-subordinate relations in the international
communist movement.

A New Era in
International Relations
The Juche idea defined independence as the fundamental
principle of the relations between parties and between
countries... no relations of domination and submission, order
and obedience could be permitted between them.
• The 1982 treatise elevated Juche from a local Korean application
of Marxism-Leninism into a universal claim on human history.
• It positioned the ideology as the definitive operating system for a
new era of newly-emerging nations seeking total sovereignty
from both imperialist and great-power communist domination.
